title: crm.contact.updated v1
description: Emitted when an existing CRM contact row is updated. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-crm-go, staged via OutboxContactPublisher.ContactUpdated (internal/service/outbox_publisher.go:62-89) inside the contact-write transaction (HybridPublisher.ContactUpdated routes tx!=nil calls to the outbox, internal/service/hybrid_publisher.go:56-62; ADR-117 §9.B — the CRM contact lifecycle events MUST go through the outbox to close the dual-write gap). The flat payload staged at insert time (contact_id/tenant_id/phone/name, outbox_publisher.go:74-79) is later wrapped by alebrije-common-go's outbox.Poller.buildEnvelope (poller.go:414-436) into the canonical envelope this schema describes: event_id = outbox row id, event_type = 'crm.contact.updated' (row.EventType verbatim), data = the staged flat payload verbatim (so 'tenant_id' also appears, redundantly, inside data — tolerated via data.additionalProperties). No schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema fail-open at the outbox_publisher.go:82 preValidate call site, itself only reachable once the validator is wired up — currently inert, no schemas dir mounted in any deployed pod). DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

contact_id.description: UUID of the updated contact (c.ID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:75).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant (c.TenantID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:76; ADR-25). Redundant with the envelope-level tenant_id — present because the staged flat payload becomes 'data' verbatim.

name.description: Display name after update (derefOr(c.Name, ""), outbox_publisher.go:78) — always a string on the wire (empty string when the contact has no name), never null.
